old: [Interpreted] Partial mitigation, reported in fairness. Both zone pairs that do share a study reproduce the direction of the overall polyclonality difference; within 1083-PF-GH-CONWAY, Guinea savanna is more polyclonal than the transitional zone (0.532 versus 0.500 - that is 25 of 47 against 25 of 50, computed on the 4,905 release-QC-pass isolates, since on the 1,900-isolate analysis set the polyclonal fraction is identically zero by construction), matching the overall ordering. That margin is three isolates wide in the denominator, the numerator being 25 in both arms, and should not be read as more than a direction. The zone ordering of polyclonality is therefore not purely a batch artefact. It is simply not separable from batch for the pairs that carry the largest differences.

old: [Calculated] Every printed edge p-value is reproduced exactly, and the apparent anomalies are an artefact of how the tail was computed rather than of the data. An earlier version of this paragraph said that five of six values reproduced to three significant figures; that was wrong, and the corrected accounting follows. Recomputing every migration-edge p-value in m = 0 to 5 as a one-sided normal tail from the printed jackknife mean and standard error gives fifteen edges, of which thirteen carry a finite printed value and two print “< 2.22507 × 10⁻³⁰⁸”. That figure is exactly DBL_MIN, the smallest normal double-precision float, and it appears at m = 3 edge 2 (z = 10.53, stable tail 3.18 × 10⁻²⁶) and again at m = 4 edge 2 (z = 9.33, stable tail 5.45 × 10⁻²¹). Of the thirteen finite values, ten agree with a numerically stable tail to three significant figures. The other three, and both sentinels, are explained — and reproduced to the last printed digit — by computing the upper tail as 1 − Φ(z) in double precision. Immediately below 1 the doubles are spaced 1.1102 × 10⁻¹⁶ apart, so Φ(z) is quantised to multiples of that spacing and the tail recovered by subtraction can only take those values. At z = 7.843, 8.060 and 8.038 the formulation returns exactly 2.220446 × 10⁻¹⁵, 3.330669 × 10⁻¹⁶ and 4.440892 × 10⁻¹⁶ — which are the three printed values to every digit printed — against stable tails of 2.1995 × 10⁻¹⁵, 3.8147 × 10⁻¹⁶ and 4.5658 × 10⁻¹⁶. Once the true tail falls below half that spacing, Φ(z) rounds to exactly 1.0 and the difference is exactly zero; that happens at z = 9.33 and z = 10.53. This is rounding and cancellation, not underflow of the tail: the true tails there are 5.45 × 10⁻²¹ and 3.18 × 10⁻²⁶, both far above the smallest normal double, and the “< 2.22507 × 10⁻³⁰⁸” string is how TreeMix prints a computed zero rather than evidence that any quantity underflowed. A direct complementary-error-function evaluation would avoid the subtraction entirely. The conclusion is accordingly complete rather than partial. All fifteen printed values, the two zeroes included, are reproduced from the printed mean and standard error through that formulation, which a run that had not computed jackknife standard errors could not have produced, resolving a doubt raised by an earlier script snapshot lacking the -se flag. None of it changes a reported result: both sentinels belong to m = 3 and m = 4, neither of which is reported, and the two values the m = 2 choice rests on are 7.48 × 10⁻⁴ and a tail of order 10⁻¹⁶ whose exact digits affect no inference.

old: [Interpreted] The containment corollary, correctly scoped. Because there is no detectable neutral barrier, there is no demographic barrier for a geographically targeted containment intervention to exploit, and an allele that establishes anywhere in Ghana has an unobstructed demographic route to the rest of the country. That remains a reasonable reading, and it is now the better supported for the absence of a robust distance effect: there is not even a weak isolation-by-distance gradient left to qualify it. It does not follow that spread will be uniform in rate or that a single site will see it first; the pfaat1, pfdhps and pfdhfr zone differences show that selection and drug pressure impose their own geography on top of free gene flow.
new: [Interpreted] The containment corollary, correctly scoped. Because no neutral barrier is detectable at the retained common variants, this analysis supplies no evidence of a barrier for a geographically targeted containment intervention to exploit. That is an absence of evidence at the resolution these data permit, not a demonstration that parasite exchange across Ghana is unobstructed: a low differentiation estimate does not measure connectivity, and the study, geography and year confounding is not removed by it. That remains a reasonable reading, and it is now the better supported for the absence of a robust distance effect: there is not even a weak isolation-by-distance gradient left to qualify it.
